# Stage 55 -- uniform vacuum-weight criterion

This stage identifies an explicit sufficient input for uniform inverse-vacuum
control and proves why finite positivity alone cannot supply it.

The theorem note is `uniform_vacuum_weight_theorem.pdf`.

```bash
python3 uniform_vacuum_weight.py --write uniform_vacuum_weight_results.json
python3 -m unittest -v test_uniform_vacuum_weight.py
```

The physical uniform Harnack/root-moment theorem remains open.
